Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

25 - 48 + 6 ÷ 12 × 2 = 41
questions.solution:
**BODMAS rule:**

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/vvZGJgyUcWRxFYwZDuDccfXc1J4Hv-wJFPUhpgi5my2vRskbP0lrpFiB5bp-Fp1nL7-DAFHVohm7qLOiDiRICqqhpJN3TRD-Ve2GlfJedfFcSqGzHEnUzLGUstVgCswZxtqJaOG9JHTLo12lyFxfeA] 

Option 1) - and +

Interchanged the given mathematical sign in given equation,

We get: 25 + 48 - __**6 ÷ 12**__ × 2 = 41

⇒ 25 + 48 -__** 0.5 × 2 **__= 41

⇒ __**25 + 48 **__- 1 = 41

⇒ 73 - 1 ≠ 41

⇒ 72 ≠ 41

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 2) × and ÷ 

Interchanged the given mathematical sign in given equation,

We get: 25 - 48 + 6 × __**12 ÷ 2**__ = 41

⇒ 25 - 48 + __**6 × 6**__ = 41

⇒ __**25**__ - 48 __**+ 36**__ = 41

⇒ __**61 - 48 **__= 41

⇒ 13 ≠ 41

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 3) ÷ and +

Interchanged the given mathematical sign in given equation,

We get: 25 - __**48 ÷ 6 **__+ 12 × 2 = 41

⇒ 25 - 8 + __**12 × 2 **__= 41

⇒ __**25**__ - 8 __**+ 24**__ = 41

⇒ 49 - 8 = 41

⇒ 41 = 41

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

Option 4) ÷ and -

Interchanged the given mathematical sign in given equation,

We get: __**25 ÷ 48**__ + 6 - 12 × 2 = 41

⇒ 0.520 + 6 - __**12 × 2 **__= 41

⇒ __**0.520 + 6**__ - 24 = 41

⇒ 6.5020 - 24 = 41

⇒ - 17.47 ≠ 41

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and +".**

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT come under the purview of 'paper taxes'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Excise tax.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• Tax which carry their significance only on paper and have no significance in terms of revenue yield are called **paper taxes.**
 
• Taxes like Gift tax, Estate duty, Wealth tax are paper taxes.
 
• **Excise duty** is a form of tax imposed on goods for their production, licensing, and sale.
 
 
• It is an indirect tax.
 
 
 
• Wealth tax:__
 __
 
• Levied on accumulated wealth or property of every individual.
 
• The tax was abolished in the 2016 budget.
 
 
 
• Estate duty:__
 __
 
• It was imposed on the estate of a person which was inherited by him.
 
• The rate ranged from 4 to 40% of the value of the estate.
 
• It was imposed and collected by the central government but proceeds were passed on to states.
 
• It was abolished in March 1985 as the yield was too low.
 
 
 
• Gift tax:__
 
 
• Imposed in April 1958.
 
• Charged and collected every financial year on gifts received during the previous year.
 
• Again abolished in 1998 due to low yield.
 
 
 
• **Hence, Excise tax is the correct answer.**
